title: Cloud AI
intro: Connect an AI service that runs in the cloud. Every call it makes goes through Manar first, and your rules decide what it may do.

providers.chatgptOff: ChatGPT is not available on this service yet. Claude and Copilot Studio are.

chatgpt.1: In ChatGPT, open the settings for apps and connectors and add a custom connector.
chatgpt.3: Choose OAuth and leave the client fields empty. ChatGPT registers itself.
chatgpt.4: Sign in with your Manar account when ChatGPT asks.
chatgpt.5: Come back here and confirm the connection.

claude.1: In Claude, open Settings, then Connectors, and add a custom connector.
claude.3: Open the advanced settings and paste the client ID and client secret.
claude.4: Sign in with your Manar account when Claude asks.

copilot.1: In Copilot Studio, add a tool and choose Model Context Protocol.
copilot.2: Paste the address (MCP URL) below and choose OAuth 2.0 with manual setup.
copilot.3: Paste the client ID, client secret and the three URLs below.
copilot.4: Copilot Studio then shows a callback URL. Paste it below and save it.
copilot.5: Sign in with your Manar account when Copilot Studio asks.
